items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Remember that Sam Morgan band? ... I was playing a long time before they were coming.

ctx.x: By Chris Cully. Hmm? By Chris Cully.

Well, Chris was a blues player, yeah. He used to play blues, man. He didn't play anything but blues much, then? No, mostly, yeah. He was up there, I guess, Sam Morgan and the fellas, you know, that's his style, you know. Remember that Sam Morgan band?
Huh? You remember the Sam Morgan band? Oh yeah, sure. He was way under me, you understand.
